# Tile

**Import:** `import { Tile } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/status-and-loading/Tile/Tile.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/status-and-loading/Tile/Tile.stories.jsx` — Sizes, DefaultSize, IconSubtle, IconBold, Logos, LogoDefaultsToWhite, Images, WithBorder, Decorative, Labelled, Interactive

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/status-and-loading/Tile/Tile.mdx`

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `content` | oneOf | `'icon'` | What the tile frames. Icons and logos are inset; an image fills and crops. |
| `size` | oneOf | `32` | 16, 20, 24, 32, 40 or 48, for every kind of content. |
| `appearance` | oneOf | `'subtle'` | Icons only. `subtle` is the color's container; `bold` is the solid color. |
| `color` | oneOf | — | A category color, as on `Tag`. `white` is for logos. Defaults to white for a logo, grey otherwise. |
| `icon` | string or node | — | `icon` only: a Font Awesome Free name (`book-open`), a class list, or a node. |
| `src` | string | — | `logo` or `image`: the picture's URL. |
| `children` | node | — | `logo` or `image`: the picture as a node, in place of `src`. |
| `hasBorder` | bool | `false` | Adds a 1px outline-variant border inside the tile. |
| `label` | string | — | Makes the tile an image with this name. Without it the tile is decorative and hidden. |
| `className` | string | `''` | — |
